text: I asked my wife what she wanted for Christmas She said to me "nothing would make me happier than a diamond necklace."So I bought her nothing
gist: Wife says nothing would make her happier than a diamond necklace, so the husband takes her literally and buys her nothing.

wordplay.explanation: 'Nothing would make me happier than X' read literally as 'nothing' being the thing that makes her happier.
